name: Pine Tree
overview: Scripture references the pine tree as part of God's provision and blessing in both natural and sacred contexts. In Nehemiah 8:15, pine branches are gathered alongside other trees to construct booths, symbolizing God's faithfulness and the people's obedience. Isaiah 41:19 and 60:13 depict the pine tree among other trees planted or brought to beautify the wilderness and the sanctuary, highlighting God's power to transform desolation into a place of glory and worship.
